definitions.title: Related Rates Problem-Solving Strategy
definitions.statement: To solve a related rates problem: (1) Assign variables and sketch a diagram, (2) State given numerical rates and required rate, (3) Write an equation relating the variables, (4) Differentiate implicitly with respect to time t, (5) Substitute known values and solve.
conditions: All geometric and physical relations hold for all t
Never substitute static instantaneous values before differentiating!
definitions.explanation: Substituting numerical values before differentiation turns dynamic variables into constants, falsely resulting in zero derivatives.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Differentiate first with respect to time t; substitute numerical values last.
